summary: Wage-claim counts that state labor agencies print in their own reports, one row per figure with the document's URL and a verbatim quote: the California Labor Commissioner's Office (wage claims filed in 2021, from its Labor Code section 96.1 report) and the Washington Department of Labor & Industries (wage complaints in state fiscal years 2024 and 2025, from its Workplace Rights Investigations reports). Each quote is re-checked against the document at each refresh. States whose pages block the fetcher or publish no count are not included.

records.agency: California Labor Commissioner's Office (Division of Labor Standards Enforcement)
records.text: California, calendar year 2021: 18,609 wage claims filed, as printed in California Labor Commissioner's Office (Division of Labor Standards Enforcement)'s Wage Claims Adjudication Unit annual report, 2021 (Labor Code section 96.1). The agency calls this an historically low number of filings. Later years' reports were not found on the site.
